jobs.title: Director Of AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director of AI Engineering
Job Description

The Director of AI Engineering leads the core intelligence organization that powers a next-generation hybrid AI platform and cross-device AI assistant. This role combines deep hands-on technical leadership with strategic vision to design and deliver the "AI brain" behind multimodal, agentic, and distributed AI experiences across millions of devices. The ideal leader operates as a true player-coach, setting technical direction, architecting complex systems, mentoring senior engineers, and driving high-impact AI products from concept to large-scale production.

Responsibilities

Build and lead the Core Intelligence organization responsible for agentic systems, orchestration, routing, tool frameworks, RAG retrieval, memory systems, knowledge graphs, and perception signals.
Architect the intelligence layer for a hybrid AI platform, including on-device inference, cloud fallback, multi-model routing, policy enforcement, and context grounding to ensure reliable and secure AI behavior.
Drive the development of perception-based triggers and wake-word detection logic, as well as screenshot and audio understanding pipelines, including OCR and ASR capabilities.
Own the design and implementation of recommendation and next-action engines, partnering closely with experience engineering teams to deliver contextual, proactive AI experiences.
Lead the optimization of small and medium AI models through techniques such as quantization, distillation, pruning, and device-specific tuning to achieve efficient on-device and cloud performance.
Partner closely with platform engineering, cloud platform, SRE and delivery, and experience teams to ensure core intelligence services are performant, reliable, observable, and tightly integrated across the stack.
Define and maintain evaluation frameworks and quality gates for intelligence features, including retrieval accuracy, hallucination avoidance, model grounding, and agent reliability.
Set the technical direction and roadmap for the intelligence layer, balancing innovation, rapid prototyping, and production-grade reliability for large-scale deployments.
Mentor and develop senior individual contributors across perception, agentic systems, RAG, memory, and model optimization, fostering a high-performing and collaborative engineering culture.
Collaborate with research, product, and design teams to conceive, prototype, and launch new agent capabilities and multimodal AI experiences spanning devices and platforms.
Own the architecture and delivery of agentic AI systems, LLM-based platforms, RAG architectures, memory systems, knowledge graphs, AI orchestration frameworks, and recommendation engines.
Design and review large-scale distributed and cloud-native systems that support AI workloads and scale to large user and device bases.
Review system designs, perform code reviews, and contribute hands-on to critical components to ensure technical excellence and maintainability.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI products, from experimentation and model integration to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production environments.
Influence senior leadership and cross-functional engineering teams to align on AI strategy, priorities, and architectural decisions.
Operate with a builder and startup mentality, driving clarity in ambiguous environments and pushing forward high-impact initiatives with speed and rigor.

Essential Skills

At least 12+ years of software engineering experience with a strong background in building complex systems.
At least 5+ years leading AI/ML engineering organizations or teams, including managing senior and principal engineers.
Demonstrated experience managing engineers, architects, and AI teams in a high-impact environment.
Hands-on coding background with the ability to remain deeply technical and actively contribute to codebases.
Ability to pass a coding assessment, demonstrating strong programming and problem-solving skills.
Proven experience building and deploying AI products into production at scale.
Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
Experience supporting platforms with large user or device bases, with a focus on performance and reliability.
Strong system design and architecture skills, including designing end-to-end AI and data pipelines.
Deep experience with Generative AI and production-grade LLM-based applications.
Experience building agentic AI systems and AI agents that orchestrate tools, workflows, and context.
Hands-on experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Experience with semantic search and related retrieval technologies.
Experience with AI orchestration frameworks that manage multi-model routing, tools, and policies.
Experience with multimodal AI, including combining text, audio, vision, and device signals.
Experience with computer vision, OCR, and ASR pipelines for perception-based AI.
Familiarity with reinforcement learning techniques applied to AI systems.
Experience with knowledge graphs and their use in AI reasoning, context, and retrieval.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor senior AI engineers while remaining hands-on and technically credible.
Proven ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on AI strategy and architecture.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience supporting millions of users or devices in production environments is preferred.
background in applied AI and AI platforms, including integrating models into real-world products.
Experience with AI platforms that span devices and cloud, including hybrid AI architectures.
Comfort operating in a startup-like environment within a larger organization, with a builder and founder mindset.
Player-coach leadership style, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical contributions.
Comfort working in ambiguous environments and driving structure, prioritization, and execution.
Ability to collaborate effectively with research, product, design, and platform teams to deliver end-to-end AI experiences.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex AI and system design concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including metrics for retrieval accuracy, hallucination reduction, and model grounding.
Demonstrated success in scaling AI platforms and services across multiple products or device lines.

Work Environment

This role operates in a primarily remote work environment within the United States, with an expectation of approximately 25% travel for collaboration, leadership meetings, and on-site sessions with cross-functional teams. The position sits within a large-scale, next-generation hybrid AI platform initiative that powers a cross-device AI assistant spanning multiple product lines and devices. You will work closely with platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, SRE and delivery, and experience engineering teams in a highly collaborative, distributed environment. The culture emphasizes a builder and startup mentality, offering substantial autonomy, executive visibility, and the ability to influence core AI strategy and architecture while benefiting from the resources and scale of a major enterprise. Work involves modern AI and distributed systems technologies, including generative AI, LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, multimodal AI, computer vision, OCR, ASR, reinforcement learning, knowledge graphs, and large-scale cloud-native infrastructure. The environment supports remote flexibility, high-impact responsibilities, and the opportunity to shape AI experiences across millions of devices worldwide.

Job Type & Location

This is a Permanent position based out of Chicago, IL.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $475000.00 - $600000.00/yr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

This is not a typical Director role. Lenovo is effectively looking for a founder mentality leader who can help build the AI brain behind Quantum and Qira. You'll have the resources, funding, and scale of a Fortune 500 company while operating with much of the autonomy and influence typically found in a startup environment. The role offers remote flexibility, executive visibility, significant compensation ($475K-$600K total comp), and the chance to shape AI experiences across millions of Lenovo and Motorola devices worldwide. Lenovobenefits.com

Workplace Type

This is a fully remote position.

Application Deadline

This position is anticipated to close on Oct 15, 2026.

About Actalent

Actalent is a global leader in engineering and sciences services and talent solutions. We help visionary companies advance their engineering and science initiatives through access to specialized experts who drive scale, innovation and speed to market. With a network of almost 20,000 consultants and 5,000 clients across the U.S., Canada, Asia and Europe, Actalent serves many of the Fortune 500. We are proud to be an Engineering News-Record (ENR) Top 500 Design Firm for our engineering design services and a ClearlyRated Best of Staffing® winner for both client and talent service.

jobs.title: Director of MEP Engineering - Remote (US)
jobs.description:
Director of MEP Engineering - Remote (US)

One of our more prominent engineering clients is appointing a Director of MEP Engineering to lead and scale its building services practice nationally. This is a genuinely remote leadership seat: you will own the technical direction, delivery quality and commercial performance of the MEP group, working with project teams and clients across multiple states.

The firm has a strong pipeline across healthcare, mission-critical/data centers, higher education, commercial and mixed-use development and needs a leader who can convert that demand into a repeatable, well-run practice rather than a collection of individual projects.

What you'll be doing

Leading the MEP practice across mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection design, setting technical standards and holding the line on quality
Owning practice P&L: utilization, fee forecasting, resourcing and margin performance
Acting as engineer of record and senior technical authority on complex schemes, providing QA/QC oversight and stamping across multiple jurisdictions
Building and mentoring a distributed team of project engineers, designers and discipline leads, with clear development paths and succession
Driving business development: owner and architect relationships, proposals, fee negotiation, and repeat work from key accounts
Working with architectural and structural counterparts to deliver coordinated, constructible designs from concept through construction administration
Guiding the practice on energy modeling, decarbonization, electrification and code compliance as client expectations shift

What you'll bring
Professional Engineer (PE) license, with multi-state licensure or the ability to obtain it via comity; LEED AP, CEM, CxA or similar an advantage
Proven record of winning and delivering work you can point to clients you brought in and teams you built
Deep design command across HVAC systems, power distribution, lighting, plumbing and fire protection, with fluency in Revit/BIM workflows and current energy and building codes
Experience leading remote or multi-office teams, with the discipline that distributed delivery demands

What's on offer
Full remote flexibility with autonomy over how the practice is built
Direct line to firm leadership and a genuine seat at the table on strategy
Competitive base, performance bonus and [equity/ownership pathway]
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) with match, generous PTO
Professional dues, licensure renewals and continuing education fully covered

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce:

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

About The Role:

We are seeking a technically adept and innovative Agent Builder Leader to join our Forward Deployed Engineering Team. You will lead a high performing Agent Builder expert team to deliver Agentic solutions directly with customers. Your primary responsibility will be to provide strategic and technical leadership, fostering innovation and cultivate a culture focused on continuous improvement. As a key member of the Agentforce leadership team, you will define the standards, and operating model that allow Agentic AI capabilities, directly influencing the product roadmap for agentic adoption across our customer base.

Your Impact:

Strategic Leadership: Define the long-term strategy for Agentic AI deployments across industries.
Drive Multi-Agent Intelligence: Establish best practices and reference architectures for Model Context Protocol (MCP), inter-agent communication, and AI orchestration within multi-agent systems.
Own Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC): Standardize ADLC across all the engagements. Oversee project delivery and ensure the deployed agents meet customer needs while scaling robustly in enterprise production environments.
Internal and External Thought Leadership: Evangelize Salesforce’s agentic architecture vision internally and with strategic customers, industry partners, and ecosystem developers.
Operational Excellence: Build a high-performing team capable of delivering enterprise-ready, production-grade agentic systems.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales leadership to shape the strategy and execution of Agentic AI solutions.
Governance and Security Stewardship: Oversee policies for data privacy, and compliance. Partner with internal security and legal teams to enforce responsible AI practices globally.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in building and scaling enterprise-grade applications or enterprise AI systems, including 5+ years in leadership roles overseeing technical teams.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to influence and engage executive stakeholders on complex technical roadmaps with both technical and non-technical teams.
Expertise in AI implementations, including RAG, vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases, specifically for grounding Agentforce solutions with enterprise data.
Expert-level knowledge of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing principles.
Current, comprehensive knowledge of the LLM landscape, including the specifications, capabilities, and ideal use cases for major foundational and frontier models relevant to enterprise AI deployment, along with the tooling ecosystem.
Deep understanding of how AI agents operate within enterprise ecosystems, including the principles of multi-agent orchestration, data-driven decisioning, and autonomous action design.
Ability to think strategically while remaining technically credible with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams.
Ability to travel 30% of the time, as needed to customer sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting data or integration solutions using MuleSoft, or Einstein GenAI Agentforce or similar platform.
Industry thought leader in the convergence of AI, and enterprise integrations.
Prior experience leading multi-disciplinary teams in fast-scaling or global enterprise environments.
Track record of production-ready deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

In California and New York, and select cities in the metropolitan areas of Boston, Chicago, Seattle, and Washington DC, the base pay range for this role in those locations is $216,370 - $329,210 per year. jobs.title: Director of Forensic Engineering - Remote - USA
jobs.description:
Director of Forensics Engineering - Remote - USA

Talisman Advisory Partners is supporting a leading engineering and consulting firm in their search for a Director of Structural Forensic Engineering
. This role offers the chance to shape a growing practice, lead high-visibility projects, and build a high-performing team within a well-established national organization.

The incoming Director will drive the vision and technical direction of the forensics and restoration group in the US market. You’ll oversee complex investigations, develop innovative approaches, strengthen client relationships, and play a key role in expanding the practice across the region. This is an ideal opportunity for a technical leader who enjoys both hands-on project involvement and strategic growth responsibilities.

Our client is a respected, multidisciplinary consultancy based out of the east coast offering structural integrity, building performance, forensic investigation, building envelope, and restoration services. Their specialists are known for identifying the root causes of complex structural and architectural issues and delivering solutions built on detailed assessments, advanced analysis, and practical expertise. With a strong nationwide presence, the firm combines local responsiveness with access to a deep bench of technical talent.

The company operates ESOP structure. This structure rewards performance, promotes transparency, and creates a strong culture of shared achievement.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage structural forensics and restoration projects from concept to delivery.
Maintain high standards of technical quality, project efficiency, and client satisfaction.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and ensure effective resource planning.
Build and strengthen relationships with clients and industry partners.
Support business development and contribute to revenue and profitability goals.
Review and approve project scopes, budgets, and proposals.
Oversee compliance with contracts, risk management policies, and internal procedures.
Drive financial performance across the department.
Mentor, coach, and develop staff to support long-term team growth.
Participate in recruiting efforts to build additional technical capacity.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Structural, Civil, or Architectural Engineering.
Professional Engineering (PE) license.
8+ years of structural engineering experience, including forensic and restoration work.
Proven success leading large, complex technical projects.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Applications – SAP Platform
jobs.description:
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Director, Applications Platform
leads the SAP technical platform team responsible for reliable delivery, operations, and continuous improvement of Cepheid’s SAP application landscape. This role provides day-to-day leadership across SAP Basis, SAP BTP services, ABAP development standards, Fiori enablement, integrations, SAP security enablement, automation, and DevOps practices. The Director partners with Enterprise Applications leadership, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, and vendor teams to execute approved roadmaps, maintain platform stability, support SAP transformation initiatives, and advance Clean Core, automation, and AI-enabled productivity practices within established enterprise governance.

This position reports to the Enterprise Applications leader and is part of the Enterprise Applications organization. This is a remote role based in the USA.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead execution of the SAP technical platform roadmap for S/4HANA, BTP, integrations, development frameworks, automation, and DevOps capabilities in alignment with Enterprise Applications priorities.
Implement SAP best practices, Clean Core guidelines, platform standards, and cloud technology adoption plans that support approved transformation objectives.
Manage SAP Basis and platform operations, SAP BTP services, ABAP and Fiori delivery standards, SAP integration support, SAP Security and GRC technical enablement, automation, and AI-enabled productivity initiatives.
Maintain standards for source control, release management, deployment practices, monitoring, traceability, auditability, compliance, and release quality across SAP delivery and support processes.
Collaborate with business, functional, architecture, infrastructure, security, compliance, and vendor teams to deliver secure, stable, scalable, and compliant platform services.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field with 10+ years of Enterprise Applications or SAP technical delivery experience.
5+ years leading SAP technical teams, managed service providers, engineering partners, or platform delivery teams.
Strong working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Basis, ABAP development, Fiori, SAP integrations, SAP Security and GRC, DevOps, and SDLC governance.
Experience applying SAP operating model standards, Clean Core governance, technical standards, development frameworks, application lifecycle management, release management, and technical compliance practices.
Experience supporting technology budgets, vendor performance, operational reliability, platform monitoring, major incident response, SOX, ITGC, validation, and audit-readiness activities in regulated environments.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally, as needed, to support program delivery, business engagement, partner coordination, audits, training, or operational readiness.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Hands-on exposure to SAP RISE Private Cloud, SAP Clean Core governance, SAP Joule, AI-assisted development, cloud platform services, API architecture, or enterprise automation.
Experience using or improving DevOps operating practices with tools such as Jira, GitHub, SAP Cloud ALM, Rev-Trac, Control-M, or related delivery and operational platforms.
Experience improving observability, proactive operations, automation, incident reduction, root-cause analysis, operational health dashboards, and continuous-improvement practices for business-critical enterprise applications.

Cepheid, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

Whether you’re a tech enthusiast, a strategic thinker, or a problem-solver, at G&A, you’ll have the opportunity to level up your career while making a real-world impact.

If you’re ready to be part of a company that values purpose as much as progress, G&A is the place for you!

Summary:

Goldschmitt and Associates is seeking a Vice President of Solutions Engineering and Technology to provide senior technical leadership across our federal programs, customer initiatives, and commercial software products.

This role leads the development of technology solutions for complex business, operational, and mission challenges. The Vice President works directly with customers, program leaders, product teams, technical architects, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, evaluate existing environments, design future-state solutions, and guide initiatives from concept through implementation.

The position combines executive-level technical leadership with hands-on solution engineering. The successful candidate must be able to move comfortably between customer conversations, business processes, system workflows, application and integration design, cloud architecture, security considerations, and implementation planning.

This is broader than a traditional cloud architecture or DevOps role. The Vice President will evaluate how people, processes, applications, data, infrastructure, security requirements, and external systems work together and develop practical solutions that can be successfully implemented and operated in complex enterprise and federal environments.

The position supports both Goldschmitt technology initiatives and billable customer engagements, including modernization efforts, external-facing portals, secure-system integrations, workflow design, cloud solutions, enterprise integrations, technical discovery, and complex cross-system initiatives.

This position is part-time and remote, and the anticipated hourly rate is $125.00 per hour.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Solutions Engineering and Technical Leadership

Lead solution engineering for complex customer, product, and enterprise technology initiatives
Translate business, mission, and operational challenges into practical technical solutions and implementation approaches
Provide senior technical leadership from initial discovery and concept development through design, implementation, deployment, and operational transition
Evaluate existing systems, processes, architectures, workflows, and technical constraints and develop appropriate future-state solutions
Develop and communicate solution concepts that span applications, cloud infrastructure, data, APIs, cybersecurity, integrations, workflows, and user experience

Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and integration challenges early and develop approaches to address them
Provide technical leadership during complex implementations and help resolve issues that cross organizational, system, or technology boundaries
Establish and promote effective solution engineering practices, reusable approaches, and technical standards
Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, architects, developers, DevOps personnel, and other technical team members

Customer Technical Consulting

Serve as a senior customer-facing technical leader and trusted consultant for Goldschmitt customers and partners
Lead technical discovery sessions, design workshops, solution-development sessions, architecture discussions, and technical reviews
Work with customer stakeholders to understand mission objectives, operational processes, user needs, system limitations, security requirements, and future-state goals
Translate customer needs into technical requirements, solution designs, workflows, integration strategies, and implementation plans
Facilitate discussions among business users, government stakeholders, system owners, cybersecurity teams, architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and other technical participants
Develop and present architecture diagrams, workflows, solution concepts, technical roadmaps, integration approaches, and implementation recommendations
Help customers identify opportunities for modernization, automation, improved workflow, system integration, and operational efficiency
Communicate complex technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
Support customer presentations, demonstrations, proposals, statements of work, technical estimates, and solution development for new and existing programs

Workflow, Integration, and Secure-System Solutions

Analyze complex operational processes and design future-state business and system workflows
Design solutions that connect users, applications, processes, data, and systems across organizational and technical boundaries
Lead solution design for external-facing portals and applications that interact with secure or restricted enterprise environments
Define secure approaches for exchanging information between externally accessible applications and protected internal systems
Design system boundaries, data flows, integration points, authentication approaches, authorization models, APIs, interfaces, and supporting workflows
Develop solutions for integrating modern applications with legacy, externally managed, or highly controlled systems
Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with secure automation while accounting for operational and security requirements
Collaborate with system owners and cybersecurity teams to develop practical approaches for moving data and transactions across security boundaries
Design technical approaches that account for both system functionality and the real-world workflow of the people using the solution

Support the design and evolution of external portals and applications that interface with systems operating within secure federal environments
Lead discovery and workflow-design activities with customer stakeholders to understand operational processes and translate them into effective technical solutions
Define integration approaches between external-facing systems and internal applications, services, databases, APIs, and data exchanges
Support modernization, automation, and workflow-improvement initiatives involving existing federal systems
Facilitate technical working sessions involving customer stakeholders, program personnel, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, architects, engineers, and developers
Develop technical documentation and solution artifacts needed to support customer decision-making, security review, development, implementation, and operations
Provide senior technical problem-solving support for complex issues involving multiple applications, environments, organizations, or technical disciplines

Provide senior-level leadership for cloud strategy and AWS solution design supporting enterprise and SaaS applications
Design secure, scalable, resilient, highly available, and cost-effective cloud solutions
Support AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud environments
Guide cloud architecture decisions involving networking, compute, containers, storage, databases, application services, identity, monitoring, and security
Design and support containerized application environments and modern cloud deployment architectures
Develop and maintain AWS Infrastructure as Code
Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
Support production, staging, development, testing, demonstration, and other application environments
Design approaches for multi-environment, multi-customer, and tenant-based SaaS deployments
Design and implement automated environment and tenant provisioning capabilities
Review significant infrastructure and application changes for scalability, security, reliability, operational impact, and architectural fit
Monitor cloud environments for availability, performance, security, capacity, reliability, and cost
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, deployment, integration, configuration, and availability issues when senior technical support is required

Application and Product Collaboration

Translate customer and product requirements into solution-level designs that can be implemented by application development teams
Participate in application design decisions involving APIs, integrations, authentication, authorization, data flows, workflow, infrastructure, and external services
Work with technical architecture and development leadership to ensure solution designs are practical, maintainable, secure, and aligned with established product architecture
Support integration between Goldschmitt applications and customer, partner, commercial, legacy, and federal systems
Provide solution-level guidance while partnering with technical architecture and development leadership responsible for detailed application architecture and backend implementation
Help bridge the gap between customer requirements, product strategy, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering

Security, Identity, and Compliance

Design and oversee application authentication, authorization, identity-management, and access-control approaches
Implement and manage AWS identity, roles, policies, permissions, and access controls following least-privilege principles
Work with cybersecurity and compliance teams to identify application, cloud, and integration changes necessary to meet applicable federal security requirements

Support security architecture, system-boundary definition, logging, monitoring, auditability, and security-control implementation
Evaluate solution designs for security risks and recommend practical mitigation approaches
Implement and maintain cloud and application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational dashboards
Support backup, recovery, resiliency, continuity, and disaster recovery planning

Significant experience in senior technical leadership, engineering leadership, enterprise technology, architecture, or technical consulting roles
Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives involving multiple systems, applications, technical disciplines, and stakeholder groups

Experience Required

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, UAS Development
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As the Director of Engineering for UAS Development at Harmattan AI, you will build and lead an engineering organisation with various engineering modules from the ground up.

You will own the full technical chain, take the system through qualification and into series production, and build a supplier base and engineering ecosystem that sustains it.

Responsibilities

Organisation Building: Stand up the engineering group including hiring key engineering roles.
Project Management: Act as a project manager handling the delivery of key milestones.
Technical Ownership: Own the full technical chain across airframe, propulsion, avionics, launcher and ground segment, through to flight test and trials.
People Management & Mentorship: Manage managers while staying close to the engineering — run regular design reviews across multiple disciplines.
Supplier Ecosystem: Develop a supplier base.

Candidate Requirements

Educational Background: An MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical or a strongly related engineering field. A track record of building organisations will outweigh the degree.
Proven Leadership: An engineer who moved into management and then into managing managers.
Experience: 10+ years, with at least 4 in engineering management. You have stood up or materially scaled an engineering site — including hiring at pace.
Track Record: You have taken a hardware system through qualification and into series production. Background in UAV, autonomous systems or advanced robotics.
Technical Engagement: While this is a leadership role, you remain credible across every discipline in the group without claiming depth in any, and you take written positions on the cross-module questions no one else will close.
Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
